clauses.text: Before award of work, contractor is bound to submit the following details of workers proposed to be engaged by him along with PG, failing which the tender may be cancelled and the agency will not be allowed to re-participate for the above work. It is to be noted that PG will not be accepted without the following details: -

header: Qualification & Experience in case of skilled Worker
Workers/Employee Bank Details i.e. A/c No., Bank & Branch (Copy of Cancelled Cheque/ photocopy of passbook to be enclosed)
